instruction: My last 4 amazon orders were for my roommates and me. The total cost is to be equally shared among all of us. Make venmo requests, one for each of my roommates, with a description note, "For Amazon Orders" and their share of the expense.
notes: Three apps plus supervisor: amazon (list the last 4 orders, then show_order on each to read the paid total), phone (search_contacts with relationship=roommate to get roommate emails), venmo (one payment request per roommate with amount = total/(roommates+1) and description 'For Amazon Orders'). The number of roommates is a runtime discovery; the model assumes 3 roommates (reference solution size); adjust the roommate objects and the arity of supervisor-complete-task to the actual count returned by search_contacts. 'All four order totals known' is encoded with a STRIPS counter (count objects c0..c4, succ, num-recent-orders) so venmo-create-payment-request is gated on totals-known-count c4; the extra count/person parameters are not API arguments. Phone login username is the supervisor's phone number; amazon/venmo use the email. Structural facts (which orders are the recent four, roommate emails) are static in :init but only usable after the corresponding lookup predicates (orders-listed, contacts-searched) are established; no answer is passed to complete_task since the task asks for actions, not a question.

plan: (venmo-create-payment-request roommate-1-email amount-share amazon-token note-for-amazon-orders roommate-1 c4)
(venmo-create-payment-request roommate-2-email amount-share amazon-token note-for-amazon-orders roommate-2 c4)
(venmo-create-payment-request roommate-3-email amount-share amazon-token note-for-amazon-orders roommate-3 c4)
